courses.summary: 布爾甘是科威特石油公司的主要生產油田；此課用大型陸上區域比較資源與地面設施容量。本課依序分析大範圍地質區分、油量不變的水負荷、集輸站庫存、不同路徑輸液功、區域計量不確定度，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Burgan is a major Kuwait Oil Company production field; this case compares subsurface inventory with surface-system capacity. The course analyses large-area geological compartments, water duty at constant oil output, gathering-station inventory, pumping work along alternative paths, regional metering uncertainty, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
